blogger_api_note: Keep false while Google's Blogger API posting restriction/appeal is unresolved. When access is restored, change this flag to true before allowing automated Blogger publishing.

strategy: major product launches with immediate accessory demand
new iPhone, Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel launches
new consoles, handhelds, tablets, smartwatches and cameras
cases, screen protectors, chargers, stands, cables, power banks and car mounts
replacement or add-on products people buy immediately after a major purchase
fast-rising or viral consumer products where purchase intent is clear
rules: Prioritise buyer intent over generic search volume.
Create original, substantive guides with analysis and buying advice; avoid thin affiliate pages.
Every Amazon URL must be a Special Link carrying tag=worthbuyin008-21.
Include the disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
Do not hard-code volatile prices unless verified on the same day.
Do not use Amazon product images or API-only product data unless permitted by Amazon's current rules and the required API/tool access is available.
Check existing articles and queued drafts to avoid duplicate topics.

strategy: refurbished technology with strong value intent
motoring, tools, home, kitchen, gaming and jewellery opportunities
high-demand product launches where refurbished, used or accessory listings are attractive
buying guides that help readers compare condition, seller quality and value
rules: Create original, substantive guides with practical buying checks.
Use eBay UK links; the existing publisher adds and verifies the UK EPN campaign tracking.
Avoid invented prices and unverifiable deal claims.
Check existing articles and queued drafts to avoid duplicate topics.

publishing.when_blogger_api_enabled_false: Create and queue drafts only. Do not call Blogger API and do not move files into articles/.
publishing.when_blogger_api_enabled_true: Move approved/generated article JSON into articles/ so the existing Blogger publisher can publish it. Only publish to X after a live Blogger URL exists.
publishing.x: Use Buffer only after the Blogger article is live, with clear Ad/Affiliate disclosure in the X post.
